WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  , MAX(subq_15.items_per_order) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__valid_order_items) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15

在 2026 年 8 月期间，青禾的有效订单商品件数为 33 件，单均商品件数约为 1.22 件/单。

业务口径说明：
1. 有效订单商品件数统计的是有效订单中的原始购买件数合计，退款不冲减件数，并非净商品销量；
2. 单均商品件数由有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数计算得出。
